headline: Wafra Acquires Class-A Industrial Portfolio in Brownsburg, Indiana
summary: Wafra Inc. ("Wafra"), a leading New York-based alternative investment firm, today announced the acquisition of Brownsburg Logistics Park Portfolio, a three-building, Class-A industrial portfolio totaling 899,080 sq ft in Brownsburg, Indiana. Funds advised by Wafra are acquiring the assets from a venture between Scannell Properties, an Indianapolis real estate developer, and Manulife Investment Management, a part of Manulife Wealth & Asset Management.
